name: dovetail-core
title: Dovetail core
description: Tokens, the Tailwind 4 theme, the recipes (every component's classes) and the configured `cn`. Required by every Dovetail component.
docs: Import the theme once, after Tailwind, in your global stylesheet: @import "tailwindcss"; @import "../styles/dovetail/dovetail.css"; (adjust the relative path) and remove shadcn's default :root/.dark variables and @theme block so they do not override Dovetail's.
